notes.title: New game announcement!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
I'm proud to finally annouce the game I've been working on for the past couple years!
Add it to wishlist and keep an eye on my social media to not miss anything!
[previewyoutube=-YfhzFQ2EPQ;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372500/1000_Obyatiya_Materi_Vsego/

notes.title: Arabic language support!
notes.content: The game now supports Arabic, thanks to mohammed saeed aka @elocoRaptor https://twitter.com/elocoRaptor for that! Also, the game was rebuild on a newer version of the engine - that's why the update size is 45mb.

notes.title: English translation update!
notes.content: An improved English translation made by Cale111.
